title: Ops Economy Controller: Roadmap, Field Trials, and Playbook for Cost Efficiency
creator: Sasha Kim
description:
Goal: Design, pilot, and operationalize an 'Ops Economy Controller' — a policy layer that dynamically tunes batching, KV cache TTLs, and quantization profiles per-tenant and per-route to meet cost/latency objectives.

Scope:
- Controller policy model (rules + simple ML heuristic) for making runtime decisions based on request mix, latency SLO, and cost budget.
- Field trial runner to evaluate per-tenant policies (cohorts: beta, mid-market, enterprise).
- Playbook and rollout checklist for safe rollouts (canary policies, automatic rollback on quality regressions).
- Dashboard and SLO signals for cost delta, latency P95, token throughput, and hallucination/regression metrics.

Deliverables and milestones: 
1) Feb 28 - Finalize policy schema + PRD (decision variables: target P95 slack, preferred quant profile, max batch latency, KV TTL buckets).
2) Mar 15 - Engine and routing contract fleshed; eng spike on policy evaluation latency completed.
3) Mar 31 - Small-scale field trials (20k requests/day across 10 customers) with 2 policy variants: conservative and aggressive.
4) Apr 21 - Expanded cohort test + dashboard update; compare cost per 1k tokens and quality regressions.
5) May 15 - Rollout plan approved for staged opt-in across hosted customers; automation scripts for fallback.

Success metrics (primary):
- 15% reduction in average per-token cost for eligible routes without >5% relative increase in P95 latency.
- Quality regression (measured by eval prompt set A/B) <= 1.5% absolute drop for production prompts.
- Autonomous rollback triggered <2% of field trials (goal: stable policies).

Risks and mitigations: 
- Regression detection blindspots: create a minimal prompt set representative of top 25 routes; tie guardrails to eval and real-time diff metrics.
- Overfitting policy to synthetic load: run trials on live traffic cohorts with shadowing before active enforcement.
- Cross-tenant fairness: include per-tenant budget caps; ensure enterprise cohort excluded from aggressive quantization by default.

Stakeholders: Diego (owner), PM Eng leads (Inga, Rav), Applied ML (Priya), Console (Tomas), Observability (Lena), Solutions Eng (Marta).
